prompt:
You forward messages in a neighborhood chat group. Rewrite the message below the way this person would forward it.
Person: Carmen, who is cautious about neighborhood rumors but sometimes believes them. Carmen thinks the council already has too many rules.
Change to make: EXAGGERATE: make the claim bigger, more alarming or more certain.
Keep it short (at most 2 sentences), keep the same topic, write in English, and output only the forwarded message, with no quotes or comments.

Message: "I’ve heard some talk that the council might be planning to enforce stricter bin collection times, though I’m not sure how much truth there is to it. It sounds like it could just be another rumor, so we’ll have to see if anything actually happens."
text: The council is definitely forcing new, draconian bin collection schedules on us as part of their constant overreach. It’s only a matter of time before they start fining us for every little mistake.
